The '''Zerm system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zerm/Legends|Zerm]].
